caption: The drawing depicts a single long dress with full-length sleeves and a high neckline, displayed on an invisible or headless mannequin. The dress is rendered in pale blue or grayish-blue tones with subtle vertical striping and shading to indicate the folds and draping of the fabric. Over the shoulders and across one arm rests a shawl or capelet in a light tan or beige color, which contrasts with the cooler hue of the dress. The capelet has a trim or fringe detail along its edges. The background is off-white or cream, with no additional objects or decorative elements, keeping the focus solely on the dress and shawl. The composition centers the dress vertically within the frame and shows no visible head, feet, or hands.
title: Gown
